changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Page Google Health records in their shared physical, civil-time, and calendar-date order.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_data_point_record_order ON google_health.data_point ( connection_id, (COALESCE(physical_start_time, civil_start_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', civil_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) DESC, id DESC );
